name: configurator-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: slot product configurator (SLOT, simple tier → shown in both modes). productConfigurator flag is on in Simple AND Pro; setConfiguratorOpen mounts the dialog (.configurator-dialog) with product tabs + per-slot option pickers; closing unmounts it.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-on
steps.failMessage: productConfigurator should be ON in Simple (simple tier)

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: productConfigurator should be ON in Pro
